references.text: 27:41 shows the immediate and fatal consequence of the blessing given in 27:30.
Hebrews 11:20 interprets the event in 27:30 as an expression of faith in God's promises for the future.
27:19 describes the very act of deception that immediately leads to the blessing in 27:30.
The birth prophecy (25:26) that 'the older shall serve the younger' is fulfilled in the blessing given in 27:30.
